name: Line communication cabinet power alarm
aliases: Line carrier and protection communication interfaces
switchyards Line carrier and protection communication interfaces
summary: Reports loss of the monitored control power serving the assigned line communication equipment.
description: Reports loss of the monitored control power serving the assigned line communication equipment. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Cabinet supply supervision” at the input and “Communication supply alarm” at the output. Channel and equipment power faults are different causes.
